response.overview: Ivan moved to Vallespir 75 knowing he would live with Raymón and Víctor, but no one told him about the fourth housemate he would have to deal with. During the neighborhood celebrations, the three young men will have to learn how to say goodbye and discover that there are people that is best loved from some distance.
